items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Now this guy on this with this saxophone looked like Joe Watson to me. ... It might not be.

ctx.x: Well he's off the boat, I don't know him from St. Louis you see. I don't know him. Between Durbany. Yeah, between Durbany. He's unknown saxophone. And Robert Hall.
Robert Hall, yeah. Emma Barrett. Now this guy on this with this saxophone looked like Joe Watson to me.
Might be. Because he played with Ridgely in a while.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: And we had clarinet Joe Watson. You heard of Joe Watson clarinet player? We had him.

ctx.x: They had alto horns or saxes or anything? Yeah, we had real alto. Old man Bob Rand. Oh yes. He played, and who baritone played? Tats Daddy. Oh yes, Alexander. Yeah, old man Alexander. Adolph, his name is Adolph.
Adolph Adolph Adolph, that's right. That's who played baritone with us. Who was this? And we had clarinet Joe Watson. You heard of Joe Watson clarinet player? We had him.
Did you play snare or bass drum? Snare. Snare. Snare. Henry Martin played bass drum.
